auditScope: Every immutable archive/member SHA; installed/launch identities; fixed registered configuration; all original CSV outcomes, p99, counts and backlog recomputed with existing tested capacity analyzer. Stability is a finite-window observation, not a production SLA. Observed distinct boot IDs do not prove independent physical hosts.

backlog.scope: Non-atomic queue_depth + in_flight observations; not exact queue conservation. Growth is positive OLS trend times observed span in the second half of the arrival window; drain samples excluded.

rawSummary.latencyScope: Conditional on returned response; accepted-only distribution is separate. All offered accepted-command p99 is null if any arrival is dropped, rejected, errored or unresolved.
rawSummary.percentileMethod: nearest rank; all returned replies retained including responses after timeout/drain; not-sent and unresolved are counted separately, not given invented latency
limitations: Fixed finite window and bounded queues; queue-full is client admission loss, not server rejection
Each worker has one in-flight synchronous client; this measures this deployed client+cluster path, not an unconstrained engine limit
No synchronized-clock one-way latency and no production capacity SLA
Execute-start is an API timestamp, not first wire offer; scheduler delay and FIFO delay are included in end-to-end latency
Backlog counters are observational non-atomic snapshots, not exact queue conservation at an instant
Pause gateway/projector writers and use isolated trial state; shared-member load generation must be disclosed
